::: {.wx-lead}
A working inventory of the databases I use most for large-scale biodiversity
analysis. Suggestions welcome — [e-mail me](mailto:xuwei.evo@gmail.com).
:::

## Occurrence and distribution

| Database | Link | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GBIF | <https://www.gbif.org> | 全球生物多样性信息设施；occurrence records across all taxa |
| IUCN Red List | <https://www.iucnredlist.org> | 受威胁物种评估与专家分布图 |
| Map of Life | <https://mol.org> | Integrated range maps and species-level distribution products |

## Taxonomy and checklists

| Database | Link | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| NCBI Taxonomy | <https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy> | 物种分类数据库，与序列数据相连 |
| Catalogue of Life | <https://www.catalogueoflife.org> | Consensus global species checklist |
| POWO | <https://powo.science.kew.org> | Plants of the World Online (Kew) |

## Herpetology

| Database | Link | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| AmphibiaChina | <https://www.amphibiachina.org/> | 中国两栖类 |
| AmphibiaWeb | <https://amphibiaweb.org> | Global amphibian accounts and taxonomy |
| The Reptile Database | <https://reptile-database.reptarium.cz> | Global reptile taxonomy |

## Traits and phylogenies

| Database | Link | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| TRY | <https://www.try-db.org> | Global plant trait database |
| Open Tree of Life | <https://tree.opentreeoflife.org> | Synthetic tree of life and source phylogenies |
| TreeBASE | <https://www.treebase.org> | Archived published phylogenies and matrices |
